The CSS framework for admin dashboards and floating bots

Karibase gives you a complete design system for control panels and AI assistants — components, utilities, dark mode and themes in a single stylesheet.

Get Started Browse components
$ npm install karibase
Why Karibase

Everything a dashboard needs.
Nothing it doesn't.

Built for back-office products: predictable layering, accessible markup patterns and components that feel at home in dense admin UIs.

Admin dashboards

A complete component kit for control panels: cards, tables, stats, charts and layouts ready to compose.

Floating bots

First-class styles for chat widgets and AI assistants — panels, bubbles, launchers and states built in.

Dark mode native

Flip the mode attribute and every component adapts. Design tokens keep both themes consistent.

12+ theme presets

RetailRidge, CommerceCraft, Blogify, Clinic and more — swap the whole look by loading one stylesheet.

Cascade layers

Predictable specificity out of the box. Karibase styles live in layers your own CSS can safely override.

Zero JavaScript required

Pure CSS classes for every component. Optional JS helpers exist, but nothing is mandatory.

Themes

Twelve looks, one API

Every preset ships as a standalone stylesheet. Load one and the whole component library re-skins itself.
